name: Broad Jump
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and plenty of clear floor space ahead of you.
Hinge your hips back slightly, bend your knees, and swing both arms behind you to load the jump.
Swing your arms forcefully forward and drive explosively off both feet to leap forward as far as you can.
Land softly on both feet together, bending your hips and knees to absorb the impact into a balanced stop.
tips: Keep your knees tracking straight ahead over your toes as you absorb every landing.
Stick each landing cleanly before resetting for the next jump.
